# legionio

**Tag**: web

## 简介

LegionIO chains tasks into dependency graphs across a RabbitMQ fleet, or fully in-process via lite mode with zero infrastructure. Optional layers install as independent gems: legion-llm adds tiered LLM routing with mid-stream failover and context curation, legion-mcp adds an MCP server, legion-rbac adds access control. All open source, no feature gates.
